caption:
Tech founders spent two years promising that AI agents would run our daily errands. DoorDash just gave everyone a reality check. People might track gift prices with bots, but when dinner is on the line, we open the food delivery app ourselves. 🍟

Would you let an AI bot order your dinner?

Source: Business Insider

#DoorDash #AIAgents #TechNews #ConsumerBehavior #ArtificialIntelligence

post.news: DoorDash delivered 3.2 billion orders in 2025, but its CEO says AI agents placed only several hundred orders in total.
post.take: Turns out nobody trusts a smart bot with something as deeply emotional as picking midnight fries.
post.insight: Consumer habits move way slower than tech hype demos, especially when money and dinner are involved.
